newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BELGO MINEIRA H1 NET JUMPS VS YEAR AGO.
newsitem.headline: BELGO MINEIRA H1 NET JUMPS VS YEAR AGO.

text.p: Brazilian steelmaker Belgo Mineira said posted a non-adjusted net profit of 26.2 million reais in the first six months compared with 4.6 million reais in the same period last year.
In a statement to Brazilian financial markets, the company said its inflation-adjusted net profit reached 18.2 million reais versus 5.6 million reais 1996's first six months.
Operating profit for the period reached 10.9 million reais when corrected for inflation compared with 9.0 million reais in the same period last year, the statement said.
Belgo Mineira's inflation-adjusted cash flow totalled 34.5 million reais, up 14.2 percent from first-half 1996, it said.
Meanwhile, adjusted net sales receipts reached 231.7 million reais versus 282.6 million reais in the January-June 1996 period, it added.
Physical sales rose 5.4 percent to 480,900 tonnes versus 456,300 tonnes in the same period last year.
